metadata.name: Marine Salp and Pyrosome Sample Dataset
metadata.description: A compilation of marine biological samples collected during multiple research expeditions (2004‑2008) using bongo nets and other gear. The data include species identifiers (salps, pyrosomes, tunicates), sample measurements (size, mass, elemental composition), sampling depth, geographic coordinates, date/time, vessel and station information for locations in the Northeast Pacific, Southern Ocean and New Zealand's Chatham Rise.
